about_the_game:
As a direct response to valuable community feedback expressing a strong desire for paper boats, we are pleased to introduce this DLC. While you may add it to your library presently, please note that the content will become available with an imminent game update, complementing the official launch of the game. We appreciate your patience and enthusiasm.

"Bottle Can Float - Paper Boat" is a new village map in the game, featuring a unique river environment and offering various paper boats for players to choose from. You can select any bottle or one of the newly added paper boats to explore this new river area.

short_description: It is a DLC that introduces a brand new serene scene and paper boats to the relaxing game. Navigate gentle new waterways by tossing pebbles to guide your paper craft, and discover a fresh collection of hidden animals along the banks for a truly peaceful and refreshing floating experience.
